# Results: ulb (generated by the training script)

Data: ULB credit-card fraud, 283,726 transactions after dropping exact duplicates, 48 hours, anonymised PCA features (no card or account id, so no per-customer features are possible).
Temporal split 60/20/20.
Frauds in train/val/test: 342/57/74.
Champion chosen on **validation** PR-AUC: `logreg_base`. Test is used only for the numbers below.

| model | val_pr_auc | val_roc_auc | test_pr_auc | test_pr_auc_lo | test_pr_auc_hi | test_roc_auc | test_recall_top_0p1pct | test_recall_top_1pct | seconds |

`test_pr_auc_lo/hi` is a 95% stratified-bootstrap interval (300 resamples); with 74 test frauds,
differences smaller than the interval are not evidence.

## Cost-optimal threshold (fitted on validation, applied to test)
Assumption: one manual review costs `review_cost_usd`; a missed fraud costs its amount.
| review_cost_usd | threshold | precision | recall | f1 | alerts | cost_model | cost_flag_nothing | cost_flag_everything | saving_vs_nothing_pct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.0000 | 0.0036 | 0.2195 | 0.8514 | 0.3490 | 287.0000 | 2654.2800 | 7727.6700 | 56746.0000 | 65.6523 |
| 5.0000 | 0.3640 | 0.9074 | 0.6622 | 0.7656 | 54.0000 | 3606.6800 | 7727.6700 | 283730.0000 | 53.3277 |
| 20.0000 | 0.4265 | 0.9423 | 0.6622 | 0.7778 | 52.0000 | 4376.6800 | 7727.6700 | 1134920.0000 | 43.3635 |

F1-optimal threshold from validation, applied to test: precision 0.942, recall 0.662, F1 0.778.
